title: RTAB-Map export comparison for coordinate-convention validation
body:
**Original title:** validate the SLAM axis convention against an independent RTAB-Map export

### Root cause

The coordinate convention used by the mapper has never been checked against an independent
reconstruction, only against itself.

## Implementation plan

1. Load the paired RTAB-Map export for the same capture.
2. Compare its trajectory against `host/src/roomscan/slam/mapper.py`'s output.
3. Reconcile the axis convention if they disagree.

Files in scope:
- `host/src/roomscan/slam/mapper.py`
- `host/tests/test_slam_mapper.py`

This is written directly into the issue body -- there is no comment thread on this issue yet.
